cloudflare.queues.operations.note: Standard operations, one per 64 KB written, read or deleted. The first 1 million a month are free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("1,000,000 operations/month included", https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
